name: Philipp Roskosch
biography: Philipp is a security researcher of the department Secure Software Engineering at Fraunhofer SIT (Germany). His research interests center on static and dynamic security analysis in the area of mobile apps and IoT devices. Besides research, he is a penetration tester in the same field. In his spare time, he enjoys hacking as a member of TeamSIK.
